'''Henke Tranberg''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Swedish National Championship]] on 8 April 2000 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations with Imperial Arrest Order]], according to Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d504">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ swedish-championships], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 11 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-11-swedish-championshipsd504/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
